absolute_wiener_no_go.conclusion: No fixed-power W_Q upper bound exists, so the absolute Fourier-bin/Cauchy energy route cannot prove F4F.
absolute_wiener_no_go.mechanism: Farey log separation plus the Montgomery--Vaughan Hilbert mean-value lower on [H/10,9H/10], where |J_H|>=1/(2H)
absolute_wiener_no_go.statement: W_Q>=1/1000 for all sufficiently large Q

claim_boundary: This artifact proves exact logarithmic Farey Fourier and fourth-moment identities, a conditional Wiener sufficient condition, low-frequency continuum scope, and a high-frequency no-go for the absolute energy-bin route. It proves neither F4F_eta, AFARI_eta, CFARI_eta, CRR-U, a Base-compatible counterexample, a cubic estimate, a density gain, a short-interval theorem, a full-method saturation theorem, nor an L-function result.

continuum_scope.boundary: this is the elementary continuum/Mobius method's breakdown scale, not a theorem locating all discrete large values

crr_u_effect.statement: CRR-U remains open. A fixed-saving F4F theorem would still imply AFARI and CRR-U, but this reduction only rules out one absolute-energy proof route.

energy_bin_reduction.conditional_effect: W_Q<=v^(-kappa) implies F4F_(kappa/2) eventually, hence AFARI and CRR-U

mobius_dirichlet_square.scope: identifies the high-frequency object; it does not by itself upper-bound the full sharp shell
